title: A Day of Mourning: The CFB Wainwright Fire

beats.text: A violent, fast-moving fire swept through CFB Wainwright in Alberta on October 17, 2026.
At 4:00 pm, a fire ignited in a training area during a live-fire exercise.
High winds reaching 69 kilometres per hour caused the flames to spread across the base.
The fire traveled 1 kilometre in 30 to 60 seconds, impacting the 3rd Battalion.
Four service members were killed and 39 others were wounded in the tragedy.
Emergency services dispatched 30 units, including helicopters and air ambulances, to the site.
Wainwright's healthcare facilities were completely overwhelmed by the high number of patients.
The nation stands in mourning for the brave members of our armed forces.
Follow Orbitwire for the stories the whole world is talking about.
